### Habakkuk Questions the Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/habakkuk-questions-lord
Passage: Habakkuk 1:12-2:1
Points:
- Questioning God is sinful when rooted in pride, but believers may bring genuine perplexities to Him in faith.
- Habakkuk struggled to understand how a holy God could use an even more wicked nation to judge Judah.
- Even while perplexed, the prophet anchored his lament in God's eternal holiness and sovereignty.
- Questioning in faith means submitting to God's character and resting content with whatever answer He provides.
